summary: Phase B (AdminTutoringOverviewPage) end-to-end verified. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed covering GET /api/admin/tutoring-overview (13 rows, summary, period_id branch), single PUT /api/sections/{id}/tutor (assign → change → remove → restore), bulk POST /api/admin/tutorings/transfer (assign + remove + invalid section + empty list), GET /api/teachers/{id}/tutorings, and auth-required guards. Frontend: page loads with AdminSidebar (active='tutorias'), summary cards show {total:13, with_tutor:1, without_tutor:12, unique_tutors:1}, filters (search/status/level/tutor/period) all present, status filter 'unassigned' returns 12 rows, Assign modal opens with 37 teacher options, bulk selection bar + Reasignar modal + 'Quitar a todos' + Confirm buttons all functional. As requested, at least one section remains assigned (Robles Miro Raphael — INICIAL 3 años A) after testing.

issues: Two top rows display 'Nivel: —' and 'Grado: —' (section A, 0 alumnos) because the underlying sections have a grado_id that doesn't resolve in db.grades. The overview shouldn't break, but worth surfacing as either (a) hiding/archiving these orphan sections, or (b) showing a small badge like 'Sección sin grado asignado' so admins know to clean them up. Today they render as '—' which a user might confuse with a load error.

action_items: (Optional, low-priority cosmetic) Decide policy for sections with an unresolved grado_id — either filter them out of the overview, archive them, or add a clearer 'Sección sin grado' label in the table instead of '—'.
(Optional UX) The toast message after bulk transfer concatenates 'desactivadas. N reasignadas.' which works but is a bit awkward Spanish — consider splitting into two toasts or rephrasing.
critical_code_review_comments: tutoring_admin.py: ADMIN_ASSIGN_ROLES = ['owner','admin','director'] is enforced via _require_admin on all 3 admin endpoints. ✓

tutoring_admin.py: POST /admin/tutorings/transfer validates that ALL section_ids exist in the school (returns 400 otherwise) and validates the destination teacher exists. ✓ Returns deactivated + assigned counts. ✓
tutoring_admin.py: GET /admin/tutoring-overview correctly excludes _id (find projection {'_id':0}) — no ObjectId leakage. ✓
tutoring_admin.py line ~95: aggregate-based student counts override the cached student_count field, which is the right behaviour. ✓

AdminTutoringOverviewPage.jsx: all interactive elements have data-testid (assign-btn-{id}, remove-btn-{id}, row-checkbox-{id}, bulk-transfer-btn, transfer-confirm-btn, transfer-remove-all-btn, filter-*, assign-target-select, transfer-target-select, reload-overview-btn, select-all-rows, admin-tutoring-overview-page). ✓
AdminTutoringOverviewPage.jsx: 517 lines — at upper bound of acceptable file size. If more features are added (audit log, history view) consider splitting modals into dedicated components.
AdminTutoringOverviewPage.jsx: loadOverview() depends on activePeriodId, so changing the period selector triggers a refetch automatically. ✓

AdminTutoringOverviewPage.jsx line ~76: GET /api/users?limit=300 is used to populate the teacher selector — if a school has >300 teachers this would silently truncate. Low priority for now but consider /api/users?role=teacher or paging.
AdminTutoringOverviewPage.jsx handleRemoveTutor uses window.confirm — works but consider using the shadcn confirm dialog for consistency with the rest of the app (not blocking).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on flows tested (load, filters, assign modal, bulk transfer modal, sidebar highlight)

seed_data_creation: Tests temporarily assigned/transferred tutors on a few sections then restored originals. Verified post-run: Robles Miro Raphael remains tutor of INICIAL 3 años A. with_tutor=1 in summary cards.
